SPORTS AND RECREATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: SPORTS AND RECREATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Replace drinking water

2. Best practice when working on Exercise and Nutrition requirements: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Exercise and Nutrition requirements with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Exercise and Nutrition requirements.
   C. Damage equipment used for Exercise and Nutrition requirements.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Exercise and Nutrition requirements.

3. Best practice when working on Injuries in Sports and Recreation ● Management of some common injuries (controll: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Injuries in Sports and Recreation ● Management of some common injuries (controll.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Injuries in Sports and Recreation ● Management of some common injuries (controll.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Injuries in Sports and Recreation ● Management of some common injuries (controll.
   D. Practise Injuries in Sports and Recreation ● Management of some common injuries (controll with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Talent Exposure and Monetization Talent exposure: (1 mark)

   C. Practise Talent Exposure and Monetization Talent exposure with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Talent Exposure and Monetization Talent exposure.

5. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the costume
   C. Only the volume
   D. The ticket price

6. Best practice when working on Game officials: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Game officials.
   B. Practise Game officials with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Game officials.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Game officials.

7. Best practice when working on Tactical Skills and Formations: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Tactical Skills and Formations.
   B. Damage equipment used for Tactical Skills and Formations.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Tactical Skills and Formations.
   D. Practise Tactical Skills and Formations with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Management of Sports Activities: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Management of Sports Activities.
   B. Practise Management of Sports Activities with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Management of Sports Activities.
   D. Damage equipment used for Management of Sports Activities.

9. Best practice when working on Basic Elements of Sports Coaching: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Basic Elements of Sports Coaching with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Basic Elements of Sports Coaching.
   C. Damage equipment used for Basic Elements of Sports Coaching.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Basic Elements of Sports Coaching.

10. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Black, white, and grey

11. Best practice when working on Principles of training Specificity Overload and Progression: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Principles of training Specificity Overload and Progression with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Principles of training Specificity Overload and Progression.

12. Best practice when working on Officiating Games III: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Officiating Games III.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Officiating Games III.
   C. Damage equipment used for Officiating Games III.
   D. Practise Officiating Games III with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Game officials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Officiating Athletics III Enforcing the Rules of athletics III and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Officiating Games III and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Ethical issues in Sports and Recreation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
